scope: Bibliographic provenance, not a change to native or project normative applicability.
method: Official dated W3C/OASIS documents, RFC Editor numbered texts and pinned native XML were fetched and read. Bibliography hrefs are the verified official documents; no runtime fetch occurs.

editionEvidence.XML10-5E: Official Recommendation heading: Fifth Edition, 26 November 2008; a 2013 link correction is not a new edition.
editionEvidence.XML-NAMES-10-3E: Official Recommendation heading: Namespaces in XML 1.0 Third Edition, 8 December 2009; not XML Namespaces 1.1.
editionEvidence.XMLSCHEMA-STRUCTURES-2E: Official Recommendation heading verifies requested XSD 1.0 Second Edition, 28 October 2004. Native Core.xml lines 598-599 instead cite XSD 1.1; applicability must be reconciled by the specification owner.
editionEvidence.XMLSCHEMA-DATATYPES-2E: Official Recommendation heading verifies requested XSD 1.0 Second Edition, 28 October 2004. Native Core.xml lines 600-601 instead cite XSD 1.1; this bibliography does not substitute native editions.
editionEvidence.WSA2005-SOAP: Official Recommendation heading 9 May 2006; Core.xml lines 582-583. The 2005/08 namespace is not the publication date.
editionEvidence.WS-DISCOVERY-2005-04: Official PDF page 1 and Core.xml lines 588-589: April 2005, not the 2009 OASIS edition.
editionEvidence.WS-BASE-NOTIFICATION-1.3: Official OASIS Standard heading 1 October 2006; Core.xml lines 586-587.
editionEvidence.WS-TOPICS-1.3: Official OASIS Standard heading 1 October 2006; Core.xml lines 592-593.
editionEvidence.RFC7616: Official RFC header, September 2015; Core.xml lines 554-555.
editionEvidence.WSSE-USERNAME-TOKEN: Official Profile 1.0 PDF cover March 2004, footers 15 March 2004; Core.xml lines 594-595 explicitly reference 1.0, not 1.1.1.
editionEvidence.RFC8446: Official RFC header, August 2018; bibliography inclusion alone does not assert universal native TLS 1.3 support.
editionEvidence.RFC5246: Official RFC header, August 2008; Security.xml lines 284-287.
editionEvidence.RFC2326: Official RFC header, April 1998; Streaming.xml lines 247-248. Preserve RTSP 1.0 despite a separate RFC 7826 reference.
editionEvidence.RFC3550: Official RFC header, July 2003; Streaming.xml lines 255-256.
editionEvidence.RFC4566: Official RFC header, July 2006; Streaming.xml lines 265-266. Do not replace with a successor SDP work.
editionEvidence.RFC1952: Official RFC header, May 1996; Streaming.xml lines 287-288. Its publication category is Informational, separate from the draft's normative-reference classification.
editionEvidence.MQTT-3.1.1: Official OASIS Standard heading 29 October 2014. Core.xml lines 8281-8284 name MQTT but do not select a version; this is the draft's explicitly requested 3.1.1 work.
editionEvidence.ONVIF-AUTHENTICATIONBEHAVIOR: AuthenticationBehavior.xml lines 5-12: releaseinfo remains 19.12, December 2019 at the same commit; do not relabel it 26.06.

sourceEditionSelections.reason: The inspected native EXI declarations do not distinguish the 2011 EXI 1.0 Recommendation from its 2014 Second Edition. The integrated authoritative onvif/spec.md now explicitly selects the dated 2014 Recommendation in its exi reference definition; the local bibliography follows that source choice, not an inferred native edition.
sourceEditionSelections.resolution: Resolved from the integrated root Markdown's explicit 2014 EXI href.

sourceEditionSelections.reason: The integrated root's wsse-ut reference selects 1.1.1, while the pinned native Core references 1.0. Both are separately named and retained. The root normative-reference row says exact native-source dependencies prevail; publication does not silently upgrade that native requirement.
sourceEditionSelections.verification: Official document title, OASIS Standard status, date 18 May 2012 and This version HTML URI were fetched and read.

representationAliases: The explicit hrefAliases table preserves numbered RFC identities, the same OASIS 1.3 spec-os works across PDF/HTML representations, and the verified April 2005 WS-Discovery publication endpoint. Each substitution is recorded in render evidence, not used to select a different edition.
additionalRootReferences: The root now also cites JSON-LD 1.1, RDF 1.1 Concepts and SHACL at the dated official URLs already retained in the AV bibliography.
